purpose: Compose transactional project patching and independent project verification into one inspectable repair route without adding a bespoke source implementation for the combination.

anatomy_refs.basis: The composite delegates the actual repair to the live capability that explicitly implements the code-patch component.
The composite delegates independent post-repair verification to the live verification capability.
The repair operates on a continuing project body rather than creating a disconnected replacement.

limitations: the composite is deterministic and sequential in this milestone
verification proves configured deterministic properties, not full semantic intent or visual quality

truth.basis: Both repair and independent verification remain visible as separate delegated steps and return their observed results.

agency.basis: The caller supplies the repair operations and verification claims; the composite adds no hidden edit objective.

continuity.basis: The route repairs the existing project transactionally and verifies the resulting continuing body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: It composes existing proven machinery instead of duplicating repair or verification implementations.
